definitions.explanation: a small vessel used to serve warmed or room-temperature sake, typically narrow-necked and ceramic

examples.japanese: お{銚子|ちょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
お{銚子|ちょうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いた→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦{頼|たの}もう→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: The sake flask is empty, so let's order another one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱燗|あつかん}→熱燗：27548_atsukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{銚子|ちょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注|そそ}いで→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧、⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{晩酌|ばんしゃく}→晩酌：14923_banshaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I poured hot sake into the flask and enjoyed a leisurely evening drink.

notes:
The polite form of {銚子|ちょうし}, with the honorific prefix お. In modern usage, お{銚子|ちょうし} typically refers to the small ceramic flask (technically a とっくり/{徳利|とくり}) used to serve sake at restaurants and bars. Historically, {銚子|ちょうし} referred to a long-handled metal vessel used in formal sake ceremonies, but this distinction has been lost in everyday language. Counted with {本|ほん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:

- お{銚子|ちょうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}く→空く：11062_aku⟧: the sake flask is empty
- お{銚子|ちょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to warm sake in the flask
- お{銚子|ちょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to pass the sake flask around
